escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: A delivery could reuse an otherwise valid handoff certificate after the branch acquired a later material commit, leaving evidence bound to an ancestor SHA.

literal_case.expected: Material drift after a prior handoff forces a new freeze and a new result-only handoff bound to the current exact head.
literal_case.observed: The prior certified material SHA 5ae7e621f8787eea3f9c0dd4492beed043823177 is historical; the current exact-head candidate 1ead51560cb6345bc011fa8123af9b591b3bc883 has terminal-green CI and is refrozen before a new handoff.

sibling_cases.observed: classify_handoff_recovery returned post-write-refreeze under the auditor recovery floor.
The replacement handoff is prepared as a direct result-only child restricted to certified audit paths.

prevention_change.evidence: Existing classify_handoff_recovery post-write-refreeze floor prevents handoff-only reuse after material drift.

detection_change.evidence: Existing validate_terminal_handoff checks parent, allowlist, target binding, published head, and current remote head before audit release.
